tagShapeMismatches.english: The gnome sells an assortment of trinkets. As the characters search the shelves, roll on the {@item Trinket|phb|Trinkets} table in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} to determine what catches their eye. Xoblob sells any trinket for {@dice 1d6} gp.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 侏儒出售各種小玩意兒。當角色們在貨架上搜尋時，請參考{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第五章中的{@item Trinket|phb|飾品}表進行擲骰，以確定吸引他們目光的物品。索布洛布以{@dice 1d6}金幣的價格出售任何小飾品。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The boss of this hideout is a half-orc named {@creature Grum'shar|wdh}. When the characters arrive, {@creature Grum'shar|WDH} is interrogating {@creature Floon Blagmaar|WDH} in {@area Q7|081}. His display of torture techniques is a ploy to impress his other guest: a mind flayer named {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個藏身之處的頭目是一個名叫{@creature 格魯姆沙|WDH}的半獸人。當角色們到達時，{@creature 格魯姆沙|WDH}正在{@area Q7|081}審問{@creature 福盧恩·布拉格瑪|WDH}。他展示折磨技巧的目的是為了給他的另一位客人留下深刻印象：一個名叫{@creature 尼希盧爾|WDH}的奪心魔（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Characters who search the basement of their Trollskull Alley tavern (see below) find {@creature Ott Steeltoes|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) bound by {@item iron bands of Bilarro}. How he got there is anyone's guess; even he doesn't know. On the first night, {@creature Xanathar|WDH} sends a gang of six {@creature bugbear||bugbears} to attack the tavern and rescue Ott. If the characters have moved Ott elsewhere, the bugbears attack the tavern anyway. On the second night, four members of the Dungsweepers' Guild ({@creature commoner||commoners}) with {@creature intellect devourer||intellect devourers} in their skulls visit the tavern. They order drinks and scope out the tavern, attacking if they find Ott or leaving if they don't. On the third night, a {@creature beholder zombie} attacks. After the third attack, Ott disappears as mysteriously as he arrived, along with the {@item iron bands of Bilarro}. {@i Reward}: Each Bregan D'aerthe character gains 2 renown.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在巨魔顱骨巷酒館的地下室中搜尋的角色們（見下文）會發現被{@item 比拉羅的鐵索}束縛的{@creature 奧特·鋼趾|WDH}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。他是怎麼到那裡的，誰也說不準；甚至連他自己也不知道。在第一個晚上，{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}派出了六名{@creature 熊地精||熊地精}組成的團夥襲擊酒館並試圖解救奧特。如果角色們已經把奧特轉移到了其他地方，熊地精們仍然會攻擊酒館。在第二個晚上，四名來自糞掃行者公會的成員（{@creature 平民||平民}），他們的頭顱中寄居著{@creature 噬腦怪||噬腦怪}，會造訪酒館。他們點了飲料並偵察酒館的情況，如果發現了奧特，他們會發動攻擊；如果沒有發現，他們會離開。在第三個晚上，一隻{@creature 眼魔喪屍}會發動攻擊。在第三次襲擊之後，奧特就像他神秘到來一樣神秘失蹤，{@item 比拉羅的鐵索}也隨之消失。{@i 獎勵}：每個佈雷甘·達耶成員獲得 2 點聲望。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Characters can find {@creature Maxeene|WDH}, a {@creature draft horse} with an Intelligence score of 10, with a successful {@dc 13} Intelligence (Investigation) check. {@creature Maxeene|WDH} speaks Common, and characters must try to convince her that they're Harpers by making a {@dc 13} Charisma (Persuasion) check. If the check succeeds, the horse recalls giving a ride to a sun elf and his half-orc bodyguard two days ago; she picked them up at an intersection (she doesn't recall which one) and dropped them off at the Yawning Portal. They talked about hiring spies to root out Xanathar Guild hideouts in the city. {@creature Maxeene|WDH}'s descriptions of the passengers match the appearances of {@creature Davil Starsong|WDH} and {@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh}. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 1 renown.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們若成功透過{@dc 13}智力（調查）檢定，就能找到{@creature Maxeene|WDH}。牠是一匹智力值為10的{@creature draft horse}。{@creature Maxeene|WDH}會說通用語；角色們必須進行{@dc 13}魅力（說服）檢定，讓牠相信他們是豎琴手聯盟成員。若檢定成功，牠回憶起兩天前曾載過一名日精靈與他的半獸人保鏢：牠在一處十字路口接到他們，但不記得是哪一處，並在呵欠之門讓他們下車。他們談到僱用間諜，找出城內姍娜薩公會的藏身處。{@creature Maxeene|WDH}對乘客的描述符合{@creature Davil Starsong|WDH}與{@creature Yagra Stonefist|wdh}的外貌。{@i 獎勵}：每名豎琴手聯盟角色獲得1點聲望。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Whichever character leads the hunt must succeed on three {@dc 18} Intelligence (Investigation) checks before gaining three failures, with each check representing 8 hours of investigation. Other characters can assist, granting advantage on the checks. If the search succeeds, characters corner the assassin, {@creature Ziraj the Hunter|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}), in the greenhouse of Corellon's Crown in Trollskull Alley ({@area T4|09f}). Ziraj surrenders to the City Watch without a fight, believing that his fellow Zhents will find a way to free him. {@i Reward}: Each Lords' Alliance character gains 2 renown. Every character who aids in Ziraj's capture receives 50 gp.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 無論由哪位角色領導此次追捕，都必須成功透過三次 {@dc 18} 智力（調查）檢定，且在獲得三次失敗前完成，每次檢定代表8小時的調查。其他角色可以進行協助，為檢定提供優勢。如果搜尋成功，角色們將在託爾克斯庫爾巷（{@area T4|09f}）的科瑞隆之冠溫室內圍堵刺客 {@creature 獵人茲拉吉|WDH}（參見 {@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。茲拉吉會毫不反抗地向城市守衛投降，他相信他的同僚散塔林會成員會設法將他解救出來。{@i 獎勵}：每個領主聯盟的角色獲得2點聲望。所有協助抓捕茲拉吉的角色將獲得50金幣。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Dalakhar stole an artifact called the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from the lair of a beholder known as {@creature Xanathar|WDH}, in a dungeon deep below the city.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 達拉卡爾從一個被稱為{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}的眼魔的巢穴中偷走了一件名為{@item 格洛爾之石|WDH}的神器，那個巢穴位於城市下方的深洞中。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Area G15b is a wood-paneled bedchamber with a birdcage on a table and a permanent teleportation circle inscribed on the floor. The birdcage contains three {@creature flying snake||flying snakes} that Urstul uses to deliver messages to his spies throughout the city. The circle is used by {@creature Manshoon|WDH} to meet secretly with {@creature Urstul Floxin|WDH} and to teleport Zhents to and from Kolat Towers (see chapter 8). See the {@spell teleportation circle} spell description in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} for more information on how the circle functions.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 區域G15b是一個鑲有木板的臥室，桌上有一個鳥籠，地板上刻有一個永久的傳送法陣。鳥籠裡裝有三隻{@creature 飛蛇||飛蛇}，厄斯圖爾用它們在城市中傳遞資訊給他的間諜。這個圈由{@creature 曼松|WDH}使用，以秘密會見{@creature 厄斯圖爾·弗洛克辛|WDH}，並傳送散塔林會成員往返於克拉特塔（見第8章）。有關圈的運作方式的更多資訊，請參閱{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中的{@spell 傳送法陣}法術描述。

tagShapeMismatches.english: {@creature Xanathar|WDH} has sent forces to collect the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} from {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH}, known up and down the wharf as an eccentric wizard who owns a submersible contraption that she uses to hunt for treasure on the bottom of Deepwater Harbor. The characters have no trouble getting directions to her Mistshore residence ({@area D2|15a}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: {@creature 姍娜薩|WDH} 已經派遣部隊從{@creature 格林達·加洛斯|WDH}那裡收集{@item 格洛爾之石|WDH}，格林達·加洛斯是碼頭上眾所周知的古怪法師，她擁有一個潛水裝置，用來在深水港底部尋找寶藏。角色們很容易就能找到前往她位於霧岸的住所（{@area D2|15a}）的路線。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters find themselves outmatched by the Zhents, help comes in two forms. Two Harper {@creature spy||spies} sent by {@creature Remallia Haventree|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) appear on the scene. Their names are Salazar Lorrance (CG male Tethyrian human) and Mavia Oxlander (NG female Chondathan human). If the battle doesn't turn quickly in the party's favor, {@creature Grinda Garloth|WDH} (see {@area D2|15a}) appears and uses her magic to aid them.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們發現自己在與散塔林會成員的戰鬥中處於劣勢，會有兩方面的幫助到來。由{@creature 蕾米莉亞·港樹|WDH}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）派出的兩名豎琴手{@creature 間諜||間諜們}出現在現場。他們的名字是薩拉札·洛蘭斯（CG男性泰瑟爾人人類）和瑪維亞·奧克斯蘭德（NG女性瓊達斯人人類）。如果戰鬥沒有很快轉向隊伍有利的方向，{@creature 格林達·加洛斯|WDH}（見{@area D2|15a}）出現並使用她的魔法來幫助他們。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Arcane runes are inscribed in a circle on the floor of this otherwise empty chamber. The circle is a permanent teleportation circle (see the {@spell teleportation circle} spell description in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 奧秘符文被刻在這間空蕩房間地面上的一個圓圈中。這個圓圈是一個永久的傳送法陣（詳見{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中的{@spell 傳送法陣}法術描述）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The kenku has kidnapped {@creature Squiddly|WDH} and taken him upstairs ({@area O3|1ac}). The characters encounter {@creature Nat|WDH} and {@creature Jenks|WDH} in {@area O2|1ab}; they beg the characters to save their young tiefling friend.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 天狗族綁架了{@creature 斯奎迪利|WDH}，並把他帶到樓上（{@area O3|1ac}）。角色們在{@area O2|1ab}遇到了{@creature 自然|WDH}和{@creature 詹克斯|WDH}；他們懇求角色們救出他們年輕的提夫林朋友。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The rocking chair is the {@creature mimic} from {@area B9b|1ef}. It heard the urchins' screams and investigated, hoping to snare an easy meal. It attacks anyone who harms it or reaches for the stone.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 搖椅是來自{@area B9b|1ef}的{@creature 擬身怪}。它聽到了頑童們的尖叫聲並進行了調查，希望捕捉到一頓容易的餐食。它會攻擊任何傷害它或伸手去拿石頭的人。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters head to a decrepit building in the Southern Ward that used to be a windmill. Therein, they expect to find the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} in the clutches of two treacherous {@creature cult fanatic||cult fanatics} named Arn Xalrondar (LE male Tethyrian human) and Seffia Naelryke (LE female Tethyrian human).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們前往位於南區的一座破舊的建築，那裡曾經是一個風車。他們預計會在那裡找到兩個名為阿恩·薩爾隆達爾（LE男性泰瑟爾人人類）和瑟菲亞·奈爾瑞克（LE女性泰瑟爾人人類）的奸詐{@creature 邪教狂信者||邪教狂信者}手中的{@item 格洛爾之石|WDH}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The dragonborn allows squatters to dwell in his home. Those who can perform menial chores are spared and fed scraps of cooked meat; the rest end up on the chopping block. These homeless sods are too {@condition frightened} of {@creature Thrakkus|wdh} to speak ill of him, and the City Watch doesn't seem to care about crimes committed in the Field Ward.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 龍裔允許流浪者在他的家中居住。那些能夠做一些瑣碎工作的人被寬恕並獲得熟肉殘渣；其餘的人則會被處決。這些無家可歸的人因為對{@creature 薩卡斯|WDH}的{@condition 恐慌}而不敢說他壞話，而城市守衛似乎對在原野區發生的罪行漠不關心。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can purchase a 10-pound adamantine bar for 1,000 gp. The genasi smiths {@creature Embric|WDH} and {@creature Avi|WDH} (see chapter 2, {@area T3|09d}) can acquire one if the characters think to ask them.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以購買一根10磅重的精金條，價格為1000金幣。如果角色們想要詢問，那麼位於第2章{@area T3|09d}中的元素裔鐵匠{@creature 恩布里克|WDH}和{@creature 阿維|WDH}能夠獲得一根。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A suit of {@creature animated armor} with {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s symbol embossed on its breastplate stands in this alcove, appearing at a glance to be an ornate but inanimate suit of armor on display. It remains inert until it takes damage or is summoned to {@area X6|27a} by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. (The beholder uses it to keep the spectators in the arena from getting too rowdy.)
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 一套{@creature 活化盔甲}，其胸甲上浮雕著{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}的標誌，站在這個壁龕裡，乍一看似乎是一套華麗的但無生命的展示盔甲。它保持靜止直到受到傷害或被{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}召喚到{@area X6|27a}。（眼魔用它來防止競技場中的觀眾過於喧鬧。）

tagShapeMismatches.english: The statues are the {@condition petrified} remains of intruders and Xanathar Guild members that were turned to stone by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. There are a dozen statues in all: four humans, three goblins, two drow, a dwarf, a halfling, and a tiefling.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這些雕像是被{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}變成石頭的入侵者和姍娜薩公會成員的{@condition 石化}遺骸。總共有12座雕像：四個人類，三個地精，兩個黑暗精靈，一個矮人，一個半身人和一個提夫林。

tagShapeMismatches.english: When they're not watching a tournament in the arena ({@area X6|27a}) or listening to {@creature Xanathar|WDH} give a speech in the audience chamber ({@area X18|29a}), ten human {@creature bandit||bandits}, members of the Xanathar Guild, sleep here. They're so drunk that, for the next few hours, they awaken only if they take damage. Also, they are {@condition poisoned} while they remain intoxicated.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 當他們不在競技場（{@area X6|27a}）觀看錦標賽或在聽眾大廳（{@area X18|29a}）聽{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}演講時，十名人類{@creature 匪徒||匪徒們}，姍娜薩公會的成員，在這裡睡覺。他們醉得如此厲害，以至於在接下來的幾個小時裡，除非受到傷害，否則他們不會醒來。此外，只要他們保持醉酒狀態，他們就會處於{@condition 中毒}狀態。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Two {@creature gazer|VGM|gazers} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) dreamed into reality by {@creature Xanathar|WDH} oversee the kobolds and use their telekinesis rays to hoist and deliver food platters.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 兩隻由{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}夢境創造的{@creature 凝視者眼魔|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）監督著狗頭人，並使用它們的念力射線舉起並傳遞食物託盤。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The second drawer contains a {@item bag of holding} that belongs to {@creature Jarlaxle Baenre|WDH}. Nar'l borrowed this magic item and used it to smuggle kegs of {@item smokepowder|WDH} into {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (see {@area X36|2cb}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 第二個抽屜裡有一個屬於{@creature 賈拉索·班瑞|WDH}的{@item 次元袋}。納爾借用了這個魔法物品，並用它將桶裝的{@item 發煙粉|WDH}偷運進{@creature 姍娜薩|WDH}的巢穴（見{@area X36|2cb}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The characters can convince the {@creature Black Viper|WDH} to help them as they scour Cassalanter Villa by succeeding on a {@dc 14} Charisma (Intimidation or Persuasion) check. If Esvele decides to help the characters, she fights alongside them and discovers treasure and secret doors automatically.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 角色們可以透過成功進行一次 {@dc 14} 魅力（威嚇或說服）檢定，說服 {@creature 黑毒蛇|WDH} 在他們搜查卡薩蘭特別墅時幫助他們。如果艾絲薇爾決定幫助角色們，她會與他們並肩作戰，並自動發現寶藏和秘密門。

tagShapeMismatches.english: During cult gatherings, a {@creature bearded devil} guards each of the doors leading to {@area A7|345}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在邪教集會期間，每個通往{@area A7|345}的門前都有一隻{@creature 須魔}守衛。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The secret door leading to {@area A6|343} can be found with a successful {@dc 13} Wisdom (Perception) check. Pushing on that section of wall causes it to swing open.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 透過一次成功的 {@dc 13} 感知（感知）檢定可以發現通往 {@area A6|343} 的密門。推動該部分牆壁會使其擺動開啟。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If the characters don't agree to Jarlaxle's terms, or if they assault him, he tries to knock them {@condition unconscious} and leave them without clothes or equipment in a gutter in the Dock Ward. He stores their equipment in {@area J16|37d} aboard the {@i Eyecatcher}, with the exception of any magic items. Those he stashes in {@area U4|3ae} aboard the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}, his secret submarine.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果角色們不同意賈拉索的條款，或者如果他們襲擊他，他會嘗試將他們擊{@condition 昏迷}，並將他們赤身裸體、失去裝備地丟在碼頭區的溝渠中。他會將他們的裝備存放在{@i 奪目號}上的{@area J16|37d}，除了任何魔法物品。那些他會藏在{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}上的{@area U4|3ae}，這是他的秘密潛艇。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Large grilled doors in the ceiling open to allow goods to be moved to and from this hold using the cargo elevator. A 15-foot-by-10-foot section of floor opens to reveal the lower cargo hold ({@area J17|380} aboard the {@i Eyecatcher} or the {@i Hellraiser}; {@area J19|385} aboard the {@i Heartbreaker}). Crates and barrels stacked to the ceiling are tied down to ensure that they don't move. These containers hold food and water for the crew and the carnies.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 天花板上的大格柵門開啟，允許貨物透過貨物電梯進出這個貨艙。15尺乘10尺的地面部分開啟，露出下層貨艙（在{@i 奪目號}或{@i 煽亂號}上是{@area J17|380}；在{@i 碎心號}上是{@area J19|385}）。堆到天花板的板條箱和桶被固定，確保它們不會移動。這些容器裝有船員和隨行人員的食物和水。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The stairs lead to {@area J17|380} on the {@i Eyecatcher} or the {@i Hellraiser}, or to {@area J20|387} on the {@i Heartbreaker}.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 樓梯通向{@i 奪目號}或{@i 煽亂號}上的{@area J17|380}，或者通向{@i 碎心號}上的{@area J20|387}。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The fantastical floats of the Sea Maidens Faire are broken down and kept in the lower cargo hold of the Hellraiser, while the {@i Eyecatcher} holds pieces of broken and experimental floats. (See {@area J19|385} for a description of the {@i Heartbreaker's} lower cargo hold.)
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 海之少女嘉年華的奇幻花車被拆解並儲存在煽亂號的底層貨艙中，而{@i 奪目號}號則存放著破損和實驗性質的花車部件。（關於{@i 碎心號}號底層貨艙的描述，請參見{@area J19|385}。）

tagShapeMismatches.english: A secret door leading to a walk-in closet ({@area J28|393}) can be found with a successful {@dc 15} Wisdom (Perception) check.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 透過一次成功的 {@dc 15} 感知（感知）檢定，可以發現一扇通往步入式衣櫥的密門（{@area J28|393}）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Below the trapdoor, a metal ladder descends to the bottom of a 10-foot-long, 3-foot-diameter steel tube with a circular metal hatch at the bottom. The hatch is opened by turning its valve wheel, which grants access to {@area U1|3a8} on the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. This area is magically pressurized to keep water from entering the ship if the hatch is opened while the submarine isn't docked.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 陷阱門下方，一個金屬梯子向下延伸至一個10尺長、3尺直徑的鋼製管道底部，管道底部有一個圓形金屬艙口。艙口可以透過轉動其閥門輪開啟，這將通往{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}上的{@area U1|3a8}區域。如果潛艇沒有靠岸，這個區域會被魔法加壓以防止水進入船內。

tagShapeMismatches.english: If he has not been encountered and disposed of elsewhere, a {@creature drow gunslinger|WDH} named {@creature Soluun Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) is here, worshiping before a shrine of Lolth. His stateroom has the following features:
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 如果之前沒有在其他地方遇到並處理掉他，一個名叫{@creature Soluun Xibrindas|WDH}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）的{@creature 卓爾火槍手|WDH}會在這裡，在洛絲的神龕前祈禱。他的豪華艙室具有以下特點：

tagShapeMismatches.english: Each footlocker belongs to a particular gnome engineer stationed aboard the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. Both contain folded clothes sized for a gnome. One of them also holds a set of grease-stained overalls and a set of tinker's tools that belong to the gnome asleep in the bunk. There is a {@chance 25|25 percent chance} that a footlocker also contains a clockwork toy, a fire starter, or a music box (as described in the "{@race gnome (rock)||Rock Gnome}" section in chapter 2 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}).
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 每個行李箱都屬於一個特定的侏儒工程師，他們駐紮在{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}上。它們都包含了適合侏儒尺寸的摺疊衣物。其中一個還裝有一套沾滿油汙的工作服和一套屬於睡在鋪位上的侏儒的修補工具。有一個{@chance 25|25%的機率}，一個行李箱還包含一個發條玩具、一個點火器或一個音樂盒（如在{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第二章的{@race gnome (rock)||岩石侏儒}部分中描述的）。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The evening before the Day of Wonders, workers begin assembling the wagons and floats of the Sea Maidens Faire on the pier. Early the following morning, the docks are a hive of activity as performers practice their routines and caged creatures are offloaded one by one. An hour before highsun on this crisp and windy autumn day, the Sea Maidens Faire makes its way to the House of Inspired Hands to meet up with the Gond worshipers and their contraptions. From there, the parade strikes out in earnest, marching through Waterdeep's streets to the cheers of the local folk. Zardoz Zord serves as grand marshal, leading the parade on the back of a rainbow-feathered {@creature diatryma|WDH} summoned using his {@item feather of diatryma summoning|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix A|WDH|11}). For Jarlaxle, the parade is a chance to show off and be cheered; he has no ulterior motive for participating in the event.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 在奇蹟日的前夕，工人們在碼頭上開始組裝海之少女嘉年華的馬車和花車。第二天一大早，碼頭便熱鬧非凡，表演者們練習著他們的節目，籠中的生物被一隻只卸下。在這個清爽多風的秋日高陽前的一個小時，海之少女嘉年華前往巧手之屋與貢德的崇拜者們及其精巧裝置匯合。從那裡，遊行隊伍正式出發，穿過深水城的街道，受到當地居民的歡呼。扎多茲·佐德擔任大元帥，騎著一隻用他的{@item 戴翠瑪召喚羽飾|WDH}召喚的彩虹羽毛的{@creature 不飛鳥|WDH}引領遊行（見{@adventure 附錄A|WDH|11}）。對於賈拉索來說，這次遊行是一個炫耀和受到歡呼的機會；他參與此活動並無其他隱秘動機。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The card players are Sidra Romeir (LE female Calishite human {@creature veteran}) and two subordinates (LE male Tethyrian human {@creature thug||thugs}). Since the force field around Kolat Towers keeps out riffraff, Sidra assumes the characters are guests of {@creature Manshoon|WDH} arriving for a clandestine meeting. If the characters give her no reason to believe otherwise, she and her thugs escort them wherever they ask to go. If it becomes clear that the characters don't belong in the towers, Sidra and her thugs attack. Combat in this area draws the attention of {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh} in {@area K3|3de}, who investigates.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 玩牌的人是希德拉·羅梅爾（LE女性卡利什人類{@creature 老兵}）和兩個下屬（LE男性特提裡安人類{@creature 暴徒||暴徒}）。由於克拉特雙塔周圍的力場阻擋了閒雜人等，希德拉認為角色們是{@creature 曼松|WDH}的秘密會議的客人。如果角色們沒有給她理由讓她相信不是這樣，她和她的暴徒們會護送他們去他們想去的任何地方。如果很明顯角色們不屬於塔樓，希德拉和她的暴徒們會發起攻擊。這個區域的戰鬥會引起{@area K3|3de}中{@creature 馬納弗雷特·切裡波特|WDH}的注意，他會來調查。

tagShapeMismatches.english: Combat in this area draws the attention of {@creature Manafret Cherryport|wdh} in {@area K3|3de}, who investigates.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 這個區域的戰鬥引起了{@area K3|3de}中{@creature 馬納弗雷特·切裡波特|WDH}的注意，他會進行調查。

tagShapeMismatches.english: A creature can climb the stairs to {@area K17|400} with a successful {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. If the check fails, the creature falls 10 feet.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 生物可以成功透過一次 {@dc 10} 敏捷（體操）檢定來攀爬樓梯前往 {@area K17|400}。如果檢定失敗，該生物會墜落10尺。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The teleportation circle functions as described under the {@spell teleportation circle||spell of the same name} in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}. Additionally, a creature wearing a {@item teleporter ring|WDH} (see "Teleporter Rings"), can use this circle to access the teleportation circle in {@creature Manshoon|WDH}'s sanctum ({@area E1|413}). A {@item teleporter ring|WDH} that is brought within 5 feet of the circle begins to hum softly.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 傳送法陣的功能與{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中描述的{@spell 傳送法陣||同名法術}相同。此外，佩戴{@item 傳送戒指|WDH}（見"傳送戒指"）的生物可以使用此法陣進入{@creature 曼松|WDH}聖所（{@area E1|413}）中的傳送法陣。當{@item 傳送戒指|WDH}被帶到法陣5尺範圍內時，會開始發出柔和的嗡鳴聲。

tagShapeMismatches.english: The teleportation circle functions as described under the {@spell teleportation circle||spell of the same name} in the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}. Additionally, a creature wearing a {@item teleporter ring|WDH} (see "Teleporter Rings"), can use this circle to access the teleportation circle in Kolat Towers ({@area K22|40b}). A {@item teleporter ring|WDH} that is brought within 5 feet of the circle begins to hum softly.
tagShapeMismatches.translated: 傳送法陣的功能與{@book 玩家手冊|phb}中同名法術的{@spell 傳送法陣||同名法術}描述相同。此外，佩戴{@item 傳送戒指|WDH}（見"傳送戒指"）的生物可以使用這個圈訪問克拉特雙塔中的傳送法陣（{@area K22|40b}）。如果將{@item 傳送戒指|WDH}帶到圈的5尺範圍內，它將開始柔和地嗡嗡作響。

numericDifferences.english: {@b Chris Perkins} December 2017
numericDifferences.localized: {@b Chris Perkins} 2017年12月

numericDifferences.english: Be prepared to make adjustments on the fly if the characters find themselves in a villain's lair prior to completing chapter 4, as the challenges within each lair are difficult for characters of lower than 5th level to overcome. You can gently steer characters in a different direction, drop hints that urge them to use extreme caution, or make deadly encounters easier. It also bears remembering that the villains are meant to be thwarted, not killed, and they are rarely spoiling for a fight. Adventurers who get in over their heads can be knocked {@condition unconscious} rather than killed. Such characters might awaken in an alley, a sewer tunnel, or a prison cell, with or without their gear. Conversely, they might awaken safe and sound with all their gear in a private residence, being cared for by friendly NPCs who took them in.
numericDifferences.localized: 如果角色們在完成第四章之前意外進入了反派的巢穴，請隨時準備好進行調整，因為這些巢穴內的挑戰對於低於5級的角色來說過於困難。你可以巧妙地引導角色們前往其他方向，給予他們需要極度小心的提示，或者簡化致命的遭遇。此外，記住反派們是被設計來被挫敗的，而不是被殺死，他們通常並不急著引發戰鬥。角色們如果陷入困境，可以選擇被擊{@condition unconscious||昏迷}而非死亡。這些角色可能會在一條小巷、下水道隧道或監獄牢房中醒來，他們的裝備可能還在，也可能丟失。相反地，他們也可能會在一處私人住所中安全無恙地醒來，所有的裝備都在，並且被友好的NPC照料著。

numericDifferences.english: A character with the faction agent background (described in the {@book Sword Coast Adventurer's Guide|scag}) must choose a faction to belong to (see "Factions in Waterdeep" below). Characters without this background can join factions once they reach the end of chapter 1 of this adventure.
numericDifferences.localized: 具有派系代理人背景的角色（參見{@book 劍灣冒險者指南|scag}）必須選擇一個派系加入（見下文的"深水城派系"）。沒有此背景的角色可以在完成本冒險第一章後加入派系。

numericDifferences.english: This adventure includes side quests available only to characters who join the factions described in this adventure. You can use the optional renown rules in chapter 1 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to track a character's rank and ascent within a given faction. The Dungeon Master's Guide gives names for various ranks within the Harpers, the Emerald Enclave, the Lords' Alliance, the Order of the Gauntlet, and the Zhentarim. Rank names for members of Bregan D'aerthe, Force Grey, and the Xanathar Guild are given below, with the renown needed to attain each rank.
numericDifferences.localized: 這次冒險包括只有加入本冒險中描述的派系的角色才能使用支線任務。您可以使用《地下城主指南》第一章中的可選聲望規則來追蹤角色在給定派系中的等級和提升。《地下城主指南》為豎琴手聯盟、翠綠閒庭、領主聯盟、鐵手套教團和散塔林會的各個等級提供了名稱。佈雷甘·達耶、灰色力量和姍娜薩公會成員的等級名稱如下，以及達到每個等級所需的聲望值。

numericDifferences.english: The gnome sells an assortment of trinkets. As the characters search the shelves, roll on the {@item Trinket|phb|Trinkets} table in chapter 5 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb} to determine what catches their eye. Xoblob sells any trinket for {@dice 1d6} gp.
numericDifferences.localized: 侏儒出售各種小玩意兒。當角色們在貨架上搜尋時，請參考{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第五章中的{@item Trinket|phb|飾品}表進行擲骰，以確定吸引他們目光的物品。索布洛布以{@dice 1d6}金幣的價格出售任何小飾品。

numericDifferences.english: Jarlaxle identifies the traitor as a drow mage named {@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) and furnishes the characters with a route to {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair through underground passageways. ({@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair is described in chapter 5. Characters who follow Jarlaxle's route arrive at {@area X1|271}.) {@i Reward}: Each Bregan D'aerthe character gains 2 renown. Each party member who contributes to the mission receives a trophy bearing a gold statuette of Jarlaxle (worth 250 gp).
numericDifferences.localized: 賈拉索確認叛徒是一名叫做{@creature Nar'l Xibrindas|wdh|納爾·澤布林達斯}的卓爾法師（參見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}），併為角色們提供了一條經過地下通道通往{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}巢穴的路線。（{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴在第五章中有描述。遵循賈拉索路線的角色將抵達{@area X1|271}。）{@i 獎勵}：每個佈雷甘·達耶成員獲得2點聲望。每個為任務做出貢獻的隊員將獲得一個帶有賈拉索金色小雕像的戰利品（價值250金幣）。

numericDifferences.english: The characters must slay {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} the {@creature mind flayer} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). They can stake out a Xanathar Guild hideout (see chapter 1) and wait for {@creature Nihiloor|WDH} to show up there, or confront the mind flayer in {@creature Xanathar|WDH}'s lair (see chapter 5). {@i Reward}: Each Gray Hand character gains 2 renown. Every character who participated in the raid receives a {@item potion of resistance}. In addition, Vajra covers the cost of any {@spell raise dead} spells needed to bring back dead characters.
numericDifferences.localized: 角色們必須剿滅{@creature mind flayer||奪心魔}{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。他們可以蹲守一個姍娜薩公會藏身地（見第一章）並等待{@creature Nihiloor|WDH|尼希盧爾}在那裡出現，或在{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}的巢穴（見第五章）中對抗奪心魔。{@i 獎勵}：每位灰手角色獲得2點聲望。每位參與突襲的角色獲得一瓶{@item potion of resistance||抗性藥水}。此外，瓦婕拉會支付任何用於復活死亡角色所需的{@spell raise dead||死者復活}法術的花費。

numericDifferences.english: Uza (LG female human Mulan {@creature commoner}) describes the threat as a "monstrous orb of many eyes" that chased her cat, Fillipa, into the shop. The monster is, in fact, a {@creature gazer|VGM} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}). If the characters met a gazer in chapter 1, they know what they're up against. Uza lends them the keys to the front and back doors of her shop. Characters find the interior in shambles and hear a cat meowing on the third floor. The sounds are coming from the gazer, which is hunting Fillipa. The cat has so far eluded the nasty little predator. {@i Reward}: Each Harper character gains 1 renown if the gazer is defeated. Uza also gives the party a used spellbook containing four {@filter 1st-level|spells|class=wizard|level=1} and three {@filter 2nd-level|spells|class=wizard|level=2} wizard spells.
numericDifferences.localized: 烏扎（LG女性人類穆蘭人 {@creature commoner||平民}）描述威脅為一個"多眼的怪物球體"，它追趕她的貓菲莉帕進入書店。實際上，這個怪物是一隻{@creature gazer|VGM|凝視者眼魔}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）。如果角色們在第一章遇到了凝視者眼魔，他們就會知道他們面臨的是什麼。烏扎借給他們書店前後門的鑰匙。角色們發現內部一片狼藉，並聽到三樓有貓在喵喵叫。聲音來自正在追捕菲莉帕的凝視者眼魔。到目前為止，這隻貓已經成功躲避了這個討厭的小捕食者。{@i 獎勵}：如果擊敗了凝視者眼魔，每個豎琴手聯盟角色獲得1點聲望。烏扎還送給隊伍一本用過的魔法書，其中包含四個{@filter 11級或以上|spells|class=wizard|level=1}和三個{@filter 2級|spells|class=wizard|level=2}的法師法術。

numericDifferences.english: 50 gp per tenday for maintenance and wages of hirelings
numericDifferences.localized: 每10天50金幣用於維護和僱傭勞工的工資

numericDifferences.english: 10 gp per tenday for all other guild expenses
numericDifferences.localized: 每10天10金幣用於所有其他行會費用

numericDifferences.english: You made a loss of 90 gp this tenday
numericDifferences.localized: 這個10天你虧損了90金幣

numericDifferences.english: You made a loss of 60 gp this tenday
numericDifferences.localized: 這個10天你虧損了60金幣

numericDifferences.english: You made a loss of 30 gp this tenday
numericDifferences.localized: 這個10天你虧損了30金幣

numericDifferences.english: You broke even this tenday
numericDifferences.localized: 這個10天你收支平衡

numericDifferences.english: In this section of the adventure, the characters should advance to 3rd level by engaging in faction missions, dealing with {@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH}, or partaking in self-directed activities. This period of time represents an opportunity for the characters to make friends and gain a reputation (for good or ill) in Trollskull Alley-and in Waterdeep itself-before the events of chapter 3 embroil them in a greater plot.
numericDifferences.localized: 在這個冒險部分中，角色們應該透過參與派系任務、處理{@creature Emmek Frewn|WDH|埃梅克·弗倫}，或參與自我指導的活動來提升到3級。這段時間是角色們在巨魔顱骨巷——乃至整個深水城——結交朋友和獲得聲譽（好或壞）的機會，然後第三章的事件將他們捲入一個更大的陰謀中。

numericDifferences.english: In the wake of the explosion, people emerge from their houses and shops to survey the devastation. The fireball didn't set any buildings ablaze, but it left eleven people dead:
numericDifferences.localized: 爆炸之後，人們從他們的房屋和商店中走出來，檢視破壞情況。火球沒有點燃任何建築物，但它造成了11人死亡：

numericDifferences.english: Twenty minutes after the explosion, a City Watch {@creature sergeant|WDH} named {@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) escorts a member of the Watchful Order of Magists and Protectors named {@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH} (see {@adventure appendix B|WDH|12}) to the crime scene. Barnibus quietly takes charge of the investigation at that point, while {@creature Sergeant|WDH} Cromley directs a force of twenty constables ({@creature veteran||veterans}) to knock on doors and question locals.
numericDifferences.localized: 爆炸發生20分鐘後，一名名叫{@creature sergeant|WDH|軍士}的城市守衛{@creature Saeth Cromley|wdh|薩斯·克姆利}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）護送一名來自警戒法師與護衛教團的成員，名叫{@creature Barnibus Blastwind|WDH|巴尼布斯·陣風}（見{@adventure 附錄 B|WDH|12}）前往犯罪現場。從那時起，巴尼布斯默默地接管了調查工作，而{@creature Sergeant|WDH|軍士}克姆利指揮著一支由20名警察（{@creature veteran||老兵}）組成的隊伍，敲門詢問當地居民。

numericDifferences.english: A Waterdavian born of wealth and privilege, Jezrynne was leaving the Tiger's Eye (see chapter 2, {@area T5|0a1}), having just hired {@creature Vincent Trench|WDH} to spy on her philandering husband, when she witnessed the following:
numericDifferences.localized: 一個生於富裕和特權家庭的水深人，傑茲琳 剛從虎眼（見第二章，{@area T5|0a1}）出來，她剛僱傭了{@creature Vincent Trench|WDH|文森特·特倫奇}來監視她不忠的丈夫，這時她目睹了以下情況：

numericDifferences.english: Characters who accept Zord's offer are shuttled by dinghy to his flagship, welcomed aboard by drow crew members magically disguised as attractive humans (see chapter 7 for more information), and led to the captain's dining cabin ({@area J10|371}):
numericDifferences.localized: 接受佐德邀請的角色們會透過小艇被送到他的旗艦上，由被魔法偽裝成迷人人類的卓爾船員（見第七章以獲取更多資訊）歡迎上船，並被帶到船長的餐廳艙（{@area J10|371}）：

numericDifferences.english: Jarlaxle owns a {@item hat of disguise} but doesn't need it to hide his true form while he's aboard any of his ships. His disguise (and the disguises of his drow subordinates) can be dispelled only by destroying the ship's figurehead (see chapter 7). If the characters somehow discern his true form, Jarlaxle gives the party a slow nod of his head, dryly says "Bravo!" and lets them make the next move.
numericDifferences.localized: 賈拉索擁有一頂{@item hat of disguise||易容帽}，但在他登上他的任何一艘船時，他不需要它來隱藏他的真實形態。他的偽裝（以及他的卓爾下屬的偽裝）只能透過摧毀船的船首像（見第七章）來解除。如果角色們以某種方式識破他的真實形態，賈拉索會向隊伍慢慢地點頭，乾巴巴地說"精彩！"，然後讓他們採取下一步行動。

numericDifferences.english: Having gravely misjudged and underestimated Lady Gralhund once, Urstul isn't about to do so again. Rallying despite his injuries, he manages to kill the two inattentive Gralhund guards who were watching over him and alert the other Zhents on the estate, who begin dispatching the other guards and servants. Urstul's goal is to capture Lord or Lady Gralhund, force the surrender of the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH}, and deliver it to his master {@creature Manshoon|WDH} in Kolat Towers (described in chapter 8).
numericDifferences.localized: 厄斯圖爾曾經嚴重誤判並低估了格勞洪德夫人，他不會再犯同樣的錯誤。儘管受傷，他還是設法殺死了兩個疏忽的格勞洪德守衛，並提醒莊園裡的其他散塔林會成員，他們開始處理其他的守衛和僕人。厄斯圖爾的目標是俘虜格勞洪德勳爵或夫人，迫使他們交出{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}，並將其交給他在克拉特雙塔（見第八章描述）的主人{@creature Manshoon|WDH|曼松}。

numericDifferences.english: During the characters' invasion of Gralhund Villa, the {@creature nimblewright|wdh} flees the estate with the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} (see chapter 4 for more information on its destination). If the characters are using Nim's nimblewright detector to track the nimblewright, the device lets them know that the nimblewright has fled the scene, but not the direction it went.
numericDifferences.localized: 在角色們入侵格勞洪德別墅期間，{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}攜帶著{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}逃離了莊園（有關其目的地的更多資訊，請參閱第四章）。如果角色們正在使用尼姆的秘偶探測器來追蹤秘偶，該裝置會讓他們知道秘偶已經逃離了現場，但並未顯示它逃走的方向。

numericDifferences.english: Lady Gralhund gave the {@item Stone of Golorr|WDH} and a map of where to take it to her {@creature nimblewright|wdh} servant, who has left the villa by the time the characters reach this chamber. Its escape is crucial, since it sets into motion the events in chapter 4.
numericDifferences.localized: 格勞洪德夫人將{@item Stone of Golorr|WDH|格洛爾之石}和一張目的地地圖交給了她的{@creature nimblewright|wdh|秘偶}僕人，當角色們到達這個房間時，這個秘偶已經離開了別墅。它的逃跑至關重要，因為這觸發了第四章中的事件。

numericDifferences.english: You come to a 10-foot-wide gap between rooftops. You can jump over the gap if your Strength is 10 or higher (each foot you clear costs 1 foot of movement), and you must succeed on a {@dc 10} Dexterity (Acrobatics) check or fall {@condition prone} on the far rooftop. Or you can cross the gap using a 10-foot-long rope line that stretches between the two rooftops
numericDifferences.localized: 你來到兩個屋頂之間一處10尺寬的缺口。如果你的力量達到10或更高，你可以跳過這個缺口（每清除1尺需要消耗1尺的移動力），並且你必須成功透過一個 {@dc 10} 敏捷（體操）檢定，否則你會在遠處的屋頂上摔倒 {@condition prone||伏地}。或者你也可以使用一條10尺長的繩索在兩屋頂之間穿越這個缺口

numericDifferences.english: The outside doors are always locked. A lock can be picked with a successful {@dc 15} Dexterity check by a character using thieves' tools, or a door can be smashed open with a successful {@dc 15} Strength (Athletics) check. Any attempt to break into the tower is 75 percent likely to be seen or heard by one of {@creature Kalain|wdh}'s neighbors. Eight {@creature veteran||veterans} of the City Watch arrive 10 minutes later to investigate the intrusion.
numericDifferences.localized: 外部門總是鎖著的。一個使用盜賊工具的角色可以透過成功的 {@dc 15} 敏捷檢定來撬開鎖，或者透過成功的 {@dc 15} 力量（運動）檢定將門砸開。任何試圖闖入塔樓的行為都有75%的機率被{@creature Kalain|wdh|卡萊恩}的鄰居看到或聽到。十分鐘後，八名{@creature veteran||老兵}城市守衛會趕到現場調查入侵事件。

numericDifferences.english: Emissaries of the Harpers, the Lords' Alliance, and the Order of the Gauntlet come to the characters, asking that the gold be returned to Waterdeep. If the characters refuse to give it up, they are stripped of any memberships they might hold in these factions and quickly find themselves in political hot water. The Lords of Waterdeep charge them with the crime of robbery against the citizens of the city. The characters face up to 1 month of hard labor plus damages equal to the value of the stolen currency plus 500 gp. If they try to flee the city, the City Guard apprehends and imprisons them. If they somehow evade the local authorities, the Harpers and agents of the Lords' Alliance pursue them tirelessly.
numericDifferences.localized: 豎琴手聯盟的使者、領主聯盟和鐵手套教團來到角色們面前，要求將黃金歸還給深水城。如果角色們拒絕放棄，他們將被剝奪在這些派系中可能持有的任何成員資格，並很快發現自己陷入了政治困境。深水城的領主們指控他們犯有對城市公民的盜竊罪。角色們面臨高達一個月的苦役，外加相當於被盜貨幣價值加上500金幣的賠償。如果他們試圖逃離這座城市，城防軍會逮捕並監禁他們。如果他們設法逃避地方當局，豎琴手聯盟和領主聯盟的代理人將不懈地追捕他們。

numericDifferences.english: The statues are the {@condition petrified} remains of intruders and Xanathar Guild members that were turned to stone by {@creature Xanathar|WDH}. There are a dozen statues in all: four humans, three goblins, two drow, a dwarf, a halfling, and a tiefling.
numericDifferences.localized: 這些雕像是被{@creature Xanathar|WDH|姍娜薩}變成石頭的入侵者和姍娜薩公會成員的{@condition petrified||石化}遺骸。總共有12座雕像：四個人類，三個地精，兩個黑暗精靈，一個矮人，一個半身人和一個提夫林。

numericDifferences.english: Each footlocker belongs to a particular gnome engineer stationed aboard the {@i Scarlet Marpenoth}. Both contain folded clothes sized for a gnome. One of them also holds a set of grease-stained overalls and a set of tinker's tools that belong to the gnome asleep in the bunk. There is a {@chance 25|25 percent chance} that a footlocker also contains a clockwork toy, a fire starter, or a music box (as described in the "{@race gnome (rock)||Rock Gnome}" section in chapter 2 of the {@book Player's Handbook|phb}).
numericDifferences.localized: 每個行李箱都屬於一個特定的侏儒工程師，他們駐紮在{@i 緋紅瑪佩諾斯}上。它們都包含了適合侏儒尺寸的摺疊衣物。其中一個還裝有一套沾滿油汙的工作服和一套屬於睡在鋪位上的侏儒的修補工具。有一個{@chance 25|25%的機率}，一個行李箱還包含一個發條玩具、一個點火器或一個音樂盒（如在{@book 玩家手冊|phb}第二章的{@race gnome (rock)||岩石侏儒}部分中描述的）。

numericDifferences.english: Kolat Towers, Level 1 (Player Version)
numericDifferences.localized: 克拉特雙塔，第一層（玩家版本）

numericDifferences.english: Level 2 of the main tower has the following features:
numericDifferences.localized: 主塔的第二層有以下特點：

numericDifferences.english: The 1-foot-diameter, disk-shaped tile that serves as the coin in the Zhentarim symbol is actually a pressure plate. When pressed or stepped on, it sounds a magic gong that can be heard throughout the sanctum. The alarm can be disabled by someone who makes a successful {@dc 20} Dexterity check using thieves' tools, but it triggers accidentally if the check fails by 5 or more. The alarm brings the following defenders, who attack all intruders in the room:
numericDifferences.localized: 直徑一尺的盤形瓷磚，作為散塔林會標誌的硬幣，實際上是一個壓力板。當被按下或踩踏時，它會敲響一個在整個聖所都能聽到的魔法鑼。警報可以透過成功進行{@dc 20}敏捷檢定並使用盜賊工具來解除，但如果檢定失敗超過5點或更多，警報將意外觸發。警報會召喚以下守衛者，他們攻擊房間內的所有入侵者：

numericDifferences.english: As established in the first year of the reign of the previous Open Lord, Dagult Neverember, Waterdeep collects a monthly tax from all who live within its official wards. The tax is 1 shard per person above the age of ten years, and is collected door-to-door by patrols of the City Guard on the last day of each month.
numericDifferences.localized: 正如前一位公開領主達格魯特·無燼統治的第一年所確定的，深水城向所有居住在其官方區域內的人每月徵收一次稅。稅款是每人一枚碎片幣，年齡超過十歲的人需要繳納，由城防軍的巡邏隊在每個月的最後一天挨家挨戶收取。

numericDifferences.english: Nobility in Waterdeep are granted the right to bear arms. In the legal code of the city, this means not merely the ability to carry a weapon, but the right to retain up to seventy equipped soldiers. These soldiers always wear a house's colors and the house's "arms of grace"-a heraldic device often borne on a shield, worn as a cloak pin, or affixed to a helmet. Others throughout the city, even foreign dignitaries, are permitted to retain only up to sixteen armed warriors, and laws against impersonating those in the employ of the nobility mean that other mercenaries and bodyguards most often dress plainly, so as not to be mistaken for the retinue of a noble. So your first clue that you might be in the company of a noble is the sight of a large number of armed and uniformed soldiers.
numericDifferences.localized: 深水城的貴族被賦予了攜帶武器的權利。在城市的法律中，這不僅僅意味著攜帶武器的能力，還包括保留多達70名裝備齊全計程車兵的權利。這些士兵總是穿著家族的顏色和家族的"恩典武器"——一個紋章裝置，通常刻在盾牌上，作為斗篷別針佩戴，或者固定在頭盔上。城市中的其他人，甚至是外國政要，只被允許保留最多16名武裝戰士，而且有法律禁止冒充貴族僱員，這意味著其他僱傭兵和保鏢通常穿著樸素，以免被誤認為是貴族的隨從。因此，你可能與貴族在一起的第一個線索是看到大量武裝和穿著制服計程車兵。

numericDifferences.english: Two other temples in the ward are as impressive, but in different ways. The beauteous House of the Moon has the tallest tower of any temple in the city, rising some seventy-five feet above the street. At its top, priests of Selûne bask in the light of the moon in all seasons. The House of Inspired Hands, dedicated to Gond, presents an altogether less peaceful experience. Here, all the great innovative minds of the city invent and experiment, attempting to create everything from flying machines to stronger door hinges. But don't expect a museum of marvels such as can be found in Baldur's Gate. At this site, "worship is work," as anyone at the temple is liable to tell you.
numericDifferences.localized: 本區另有兩座同樣令人印象深刻、卻各具特色的神殿。美麗的月之屋擁有全城神殿中最高的塔，塔頂高出街面約75尺。塞倫涅的祭司一年四季都在塔頂沐浴月光。獻給貢德的巧手之屋則遠不如前者寧靜。城中偉大的創新者在此發明、實驗，試圖打造從飛行機器到更堅固門鉸鏈的各種事物。不過，別期待這裡有博德之門那樣的奇妙博物館。在此處，正如神殿裡任何人都可能告訴你的：「工作即崇拜。」

numericDifferences.english: Over a century ago, just one of these eight behemoth statues stood visible at the northern foot of Mount Waterdeep, on a bluff called Gull Leap. Ninety feet tall, it resembled a bald human staring out to sea. Later events (discussed below) caused it to be transformed into the statue known today as the Sahuagin Humbled.
numericDifferences.localized: 一個多世紀前，在深水城山北麓被稱為海鷗跳躍的峭壁上，只有這八個巨像中的一個明顯可見。它高90尺，看起來像一個禿頂的人凝視著大海。後來的事件（下面討論）導致它被改造成今天眾所周知的鯊華魚人謙卑雕像。
